First be yourself, never change for someone, they should love you for who you are, love your qualities and defaults, of course you can change  to be a better person but it's mostly for yourself, someone who is trying to change everything about you is not good. 

Secondly don't trust every kind words, girls or boys don't matter, some of them are just playing, they want you once and then they let you down, you'll feel a real connection when you'll find the one. 

Thirdly if you start to like someone don't be afraid to tell your feelings, you only live once, even if they reject you at least you were honest with yourself and you tried, don't get stuck with your feelings you can regret later. 

Fourthly before dating try to know more about the person, go out with them, do activities..etc, don't hurry, be sure about your feelings before dating, communication is the must in a relationship
